jina: The President of the United Republic
maudhui: (1) There shall be a President of the United Republic. (2) The President shall be the Head of State, the Head of Government and the Commander-in-Chief of the Armed Forces.
vifungu: (1) There shall be a President of the United Republic.
(2) The President shall be the Head of State, the Head of Government and the Commander-in-Chief of the Armed Forces.
